definitions.explanation: A person who is learning a skill or trade by watching and imitating experienced workers. Also used as a prefix meaning 'trainee' or 'apprentice.'
The act or period of learning by watching and imitating others in a workplace or craft.

examples.japanese: {見習|みなら}い⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work as a trainee nurse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{見習|みなら}いだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{任|まか}せられない→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: He's still an apprentice, so we can't leave him on his own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見習|みなら}い⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I trained for three years as a chef's apprentice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見習|みなら}い⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧です。
examples.english: The first month is a probation period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見習|みなら}い⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけた。
examples.english: I acquired skills by watching and learning from my senior colleagues.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見習|みなら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: At this workplace, the salary is low until the training period is over.

notes: Derived from the verb ⟦{見習|みなら}う→見習う：04581_minarau⟧ (to learn by watching). Often used as a prefix: {見習|みなら}い⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧ (trainee nurse), {見習|みなら}い⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧ (trainee driver). Common collocations: {見習|みなら}い⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (probation/training period), {見習|みなら}い⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in training). In traditional crafts, a {見習|みなら}い learns by observing the master, reflecting the Japanese approach to skill acquisition through imitation rather than formal instruction.
